value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Porterville/Tulare County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

value: Only one inspection shall be required and performed by the Engineering and Building Division, covering roof clearances, ingress/egress, flashing installation, smoke alarms, carbon monoxide detectors, and SB 407 noncompliant-plumbing-fixture replacement

The inspection shall be done in a timely manner and should include consolidated inspections; an inspection will be scheduled within two business days of a request and assigned a two-hour inspection window
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is required
